messages:
laura: FYI I'm opening a small PR to refresh the 'hello-dock' quickstart. Main goals: clarify auth (env vs file), swap in a multi-stage Dockerfile, add CI secret example, and a short note about not committing creds. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321

aj: Cool. Is this mostly copy edits or are you changing runnable snippets too?

laura: Both. Tightening copy and replacing a couple of snippets. No app logic changes. I switched inline token usage to an .env pattern and updated the Dockerfile to multi-stage for smaller images.

kevin: Paste the new Dockerfile here so I can eyeball it quickly.

laura: Pasting the Dockerfile:

```dockerfile
# build stage
FROM python:3.11-slim AS builder
WORKDIR /build
COPY pyproject.toml requirements.txt ./
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt -t /build/.deps

# runtime stage
FROM python:3.11-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=builder /build/.deps /app/.deps
COPY . /app
ENV PYTHONPATH=/app/.deps:/app
COPY --chown=1000:1000 . /app
CMD ["python", "app.py"]
```

mike: Looks good. Two minor asks: 1) show how to set the env var locally (e.g., `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...`) and 2) include a minimal .env example so people don't accidentally commit credentials.

laura: Added: "Create a .env file (do not commit) with REDWOOD_API_KEY=your_token_here and use direnv or python-dotenv for local testing."

kevin: Also add a one-liner for GH Actions secrets: `echo \"$REDWOOD_API_KEY\" | gh secret set REDWOOD_API_KEY` so users know how to set it in CI.

laura: Good idea  I'll add a minimal workflow snippet that references the quickstart.

aj: Make sure the SDK call uses the current stable pattern (we had a deprecation around SDK 5->6). Which method are you calling in the example?

laura: Using `client.generate()` from the SDK wrapper, which is the recommended way in our docs today. I verified locally against a mock.

kevin: Docsbot, can you run link-check on the changed files?

docsbot: Running link-check... Found 1 broken internal link in docs/quickstarts/hello-dock.md: ./old-auth.md -> should be ../auth/setup.md

laura: Patched that in the PR.

mike: Please add a short callout about rate limits: if you expect >10 req/s consider Dedicated or batching; link to /docs/dedicated/overview.

laura: Added a brief aside and the link.

aj: I'll review now. If it's fine I can approve and we can cherry-pick to the v-next branch.

kevin: One safety note: avoid examples that print tokens to stdout (no `echo $TOKEN` unguarded).

laura: Replaced risky examples with placeholders like `printf '***'`. Also added a tiny Docker networking troubleshooting tip for macOS: use `--network=host` if localhost:3000 is unreachable.

mike: Optional nit: set non-root ownership in the runtime stage (`--chown=1000:1000`)  looks like you already added that.

laura: Yepadded and tested. Local build smoke: `Successfully built hello-dock:local (size 82MB)`  included in PR description as proof.

aj: Left two small wording comments, nothing blocking.

laura: Thanks everyone. I'll address comments and merge after CI green. Ping here for any follow-ups. :rocket:
